full_judgment: 4. The defendant contested the suit by filing a written statement on 9-2-1994 denying the materials and allegation made in the plaint and contending, inter alia, that the suit is barred by limitation and that the accounts made in the plaint is not correct account. The positive case of the defendant is that due to business loss and flood in 1988 plaintiff suffered enormous loss in business as such he could not pay of the loan amount. Ultimately, he filed an application before the higher authorities of the bank to waive his loan amount as well as the interest and penal interest by letter dated 30-7-1994 and which was recommended by the influential people of the locality. It was further stated that defendant is always ready and willing to pay the loan amount and to get rid of the said loan amount. With these averments the defendant prayed for dismissal of the suit.
